about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for hse-l56 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Status labels are shifted: the regulation text is labelled guidance, ACOP paragraph 200 is labelled regulation, and guidance paragraph 201 is labelled ACOP.
The text of regulation 18(1) and (2) is merged into the summary box text instead of being a separate regulation provision.
findings.evidence: tree: "of the need for equipotential bonding. 1) No person shall install any installation pipework"

findings.problem: ACOP and guidance paragraphs 200-203 are placed under the 'Summary of regulation 18' heading.
findings.evidence: tree: "Regulation 18 Safe use of pipes > Summary of regulation 18 > Paragraph 200"

findings.problem: The status labels are shifted: ACOP paragraph 200 is marked as regulation and guidance paragraph 201 is marked as acop.
findings.evidence: source: "ACOP 18(1)-(2) 200 The location and routing..." / tree: para-200 "status": "regulation"; para-201 "status": "acop"

findings.problem: The regulation 18(1)-(2) text is merged into the summary box block, and the block is marked as guidance, not regulation.
findings.evidence: source: "Regulation 18(1)-(2) 1) No person shall install..." / tree: "Summary of regulation 18 ... 1) No person shall install" status "guidance"

findings.problem: Paragraph 304 sits in the Guidance 36A box but is labelled as regulation text.
findings.evidence: source: "Guidance 36A ... 304 The changes set out in regulation 36A" / tree: "number": "304", "status": "regulation"

findings.problem: Paragraph 304 sits in the Guidance 36A box but is labelled as regulation text.
findings.evidence: source: "Guidance 36A ... 304 The changes set out in regulation 36A" / tree: "number": "304", "status": "regulation"

findings.problem: Regulation 36A(4) and guidance paragraphs 304 and 305 are placed under the 'Summary of regulation 36A' heading, which only covers the summary box.
The text of Regulation 40A, printed as regulation text in a Regulation box, is marked as guidance in the tree.
findings.evidence: source: "Regulation 40A (1) The Secretary of State must from time to time" / tree: status "guidance"

findings.problem: The footnote saying Regulation 40A was added in 2018 is attached under Regulation 41 instead of Regulation 40A.
findings.evidence: tree: "Regulation 41 Revocation and amendments > Text": "1 Regulation 40A was added by the Gas Safety (Installation and Use) (Amendment) Regulations 2018."

findings.problem: A space is lost between the year and the next word, twice.
A stray note holding only the regulator and meter labels 'R M' from Figure 10 sits between the figures as if it were page text; those labels are also missing from Figure 10's labels.
The regulation 2(1) definition of 'flue', printed in its own Regulation box, is merged into the end of guidance paragraph 26 and marked as guidance.
findings.evidence: tree para 26: "...in the Introduction). “flue” means a passage for conveying the products of combustion from a gas appliance to the external air..."

findings.problem: The regulation 2(1) definition of 'gas', printed in its own Regulation box, is merged into the end of guidance paragraph 27 and marked as guidance.
findings.evidence: tree para 27: "...document list). “gas” means any substance which is or (if it were in a gaseous state) would be gas..."
